records.claim: The first four frozen H62 pairs completed with exact shared ancestry, one review call per arm, sole compact-slate exposure, known usage, and bounded paired token differences. Their fixed-eight-denominator contribution was -0.0000123 macro Span-F1, effectively neutral.
limitations: Four pairs are absent from the fixed denominator.
Span and file precision nondegradation do not pass on this partial evidence.

records.claim: Task five's third model request reached the frozen 300-second deadline with no response bytes and no provider token usage. The driver retained the failed receipt and stopped before either branch because unknown usage cannot form an accountable review boundary.
limitations: No task-five branch, retry, replacement, or later cell occurred.
This is provider-latency counterevidence, not a complete H62 quality test.

records.next_action: Retain H62 and adapter v3 unchanged. Raise the frozen model request timeout from 300 to 900 seconds because elapsed time is outside the token objective, keep zero automatic retries and the global stop on unknown usage, then run a new fresh scoreability-gated cohort.

selected_successor: H62 retained with 900-second zero-retry request timeout
